dispositions.sourceDisposition: Recognizes an externally supplied fiduciary-activity assertion. Public accountability turns on holding assets for a broad group of outsiders as a primary business; incidental activity alone does not establish it. Amount/materiality is not a substitute for this business-purpose assessment. MATERIAL_FIDUCIARY is a legacy label requiring primary-versus-incidental evidence, not an amount threshold.

Recognizes an externally supplied undue-cost-or-effort assertion. Relief requires an express exemption and dated entity-specific management judgment of incremental cost/effort against user benefits, assessed anew where subsequent relief applies. Disclose the fact and reasons, with the specific 19.16/19.38 disclosure exception assessed separately. No universal numeric cutoff is implied.

Recognizes an externally supplied representative-price assertion. Use the price within the bid–ask spread most representative of fair value in the circumstances; asset-bid/liability-ask is permitted, not required. Supported mid-market or other market-participant conventions may apply. The recognizer does not calculate fair value.

Recognizes an externally supplied finite-useful-life assertion. All intangible assets have finite useful lives; when life cannot be established reliably, management uses its best estimate not exceeding ten years. Ten is a cap, never an automatic default. The indefinite-life machine identifier is retained solely for compatibility; legal/contractual limits remain separately applicable.

Recognizes an externally supplied goodwill useful-life assertion. If life cannot be established reliably, use management’s best estimate not exceeding ten years, never an automatic ten-year assignment. Amortisation and impairment require their applicable separate assessments; this recognizer performs no financial calculation.

Recognizes an externally supplied actuarial-gains/losses assertion within the documented OCI election. The Standard also permits a profit-or-loss election; either policy applies consistently to all defined benefit plans and all actuarial gains/losses in their period of occurrence. This OCI-labelled recognizer does not mandate OCI or represent the profit-or-loss pathway by itself.
